as_told.title: Chariots of the Gods: ancient astronauts started civilization

plain: Ancient gods are said to have really been alien astronauts arriving in spaceships, and ancient sites such as Easter Island are offered as traces of their visits. This is the idea made famous by the writer Erich von Däniken. Michels sets it out in a 2022 episode, naming von Däniken's book Chariots of the Gods, published in 1968. As he puts it, "ancient alien astronauts came down to Earth around 10,000 years ago at the time of the agrarian revolution", when people first took up farming, and "taught us how to basically start modern civilization." If true, it would mean that human civilization was handed down to us rather than built by us. The skeptic writer Michael Shermer also brings it up, in passing, during a 2026 debate with Michels. He sums it up as "the ancient alien gods that are actually, you know, spaceships", and ties it to the wider ancient-alien genre. Shermer gives no date and no detail of the supposed visit.
